query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                 SELECT 1 FROM runs r
                  WHERE r.task_id = ?1
                    AND (r.base_ref = ?2
                         OR r.base_sha IN (SELECT head_sha FROM runs
                                            WHERE task_id = ?3
                                              AND head_sha IS NOT NULL
                                              AND base_sha IS NOT NULL
                                              AND head_sha <> base_sha))
               ) AS "built_on!: bool"
